selective_builtin_loading.behavior: Only selected builtin OTNs are loaded as explicit headerless rules. DetectionEngine::queue_event(gid,sid) returns before queue allocation when OtnLookup finds no rule; disabled unrelated builtins therefore cannot consume this profile's event queue.

atomic_fragment_provenance.behavior: Ipv6FragCodec::decode queues DECODE_IPV6_BAD_FRAG_PKT (116:458) when fragment offset and M flag are both zero; this is independent of payload length and protocol.
